record.dic_text:
08174 Sha`aph {shah'-af}

源自 05586; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Shaaph 2; 2

沙亞弗 = "分區"
1) 耶拉篾的兄弟迦勒家族之雅代的兒子(#代上 2:47|)
2) 耶拉篾的兄弟迦勒和其妾瑪迦所生之子, 是麥瑪拿的祖先(#代上 2:49|)
record.edic_text:
08174 Sha`aph {shah'-af}

from 05586;; n pr m

AV - Shaaph 2; 2

Shaaph = "division"
1) son of Jahdai of the family of Caleb, the brother of Jerahmeel
2) son of Caleb, the brother of Jerahmeel, by his concubine Maachah
   and father of Madmannah
